q: Cloud computing is defined on the slides as the delivery of computing as:
o: A product you buy and own
A service, metered over a network
e: On-demand IT services on a pay-as-you-go basis over the Internet.

q: Which of the 5 V's describes data quality and accuracy?
e: Veracity = trustworthiness of the data.

q: Which is NOT one of NIST's five essential characteristics?
e: The five: on-demand self-service, broad network access, resource pooling, rapid elasticity, measured service.

q: Provisioning a server yourself without contacting the provider's staff illustrates:
e: No human interaction from the provider.

q: Multiple customers sharing the same physical infrastructure securely is called:
e: Tenants share hardware but are isolated.

q: In IaaS, the customer manages:
o: The OS and everything above it
e: The provider manages virtualization, servers, storage and networking.

q: Google App Engine and Heroku are examples of:
e: Developers focus only on code.

q: Gmail, Salesforce and Zoom are examples of:
e: Complete software delivered over the Internet.

q: AWS Lambda is an example of:
e: Function as a Service (serverless).

q: A cloud operated exclusively for one organization is a:
e: High security, control and compliance.

q: Using AWS and Azure and GCP at the same time is:
e: Hybrid = private + public; multi-cloud = several public providers.

q: The main reason enterprises adopt multi-cloud, per the slides, includes:
e: Also best-of-breed, compliance, cost arbitrage, redundancy.

q: Which is described as the core enabler of cloud computing?
e: A hypervisor splits hardware into many VMs.

q: Containers differ from VMs because containers:
o: Each have a full guest OS
e: Lighter, faster, more portable.

q: Which is NOT a Kubernetes feature listed on slide 26?
e: K8s manages containers; it doesn't write code.

q: 'Serverless' means:
e: The provider provisions and scales servers.

q: A disadvantage of serverless computing is:
e: Also harder debugging.

q: Which tier has ultra-low latency below 10 ms?
e: Fog 10-50 ms; cloud 50-150 ms.

q: Under the shared responsibility model, the provider secures:
e: Security OF the cloud = provider; IN the cloud = customer.

q: Zero Trust is summarised as:
e: Principles: verify explicitly, least privilege, assume breach.

q: Spot/preemptible VMs are best for:
e: 60-90% cheaper but can be reclaimed.

q: Reserved instances can save up to about:
e: 1-3 year commitment for predictable workloads.

q: Which regulation governs EU personal data, including the right to erasure?
e: HIPAA = US health; PCI-DSS = card data.

q: Deliberately injecting failures to test resilience is called:
e: E.g. Netflix Chaos Monkey.

q: According to the slides, the cloud market leader in 2024 was:
e: AWS 31%, Azure 25%, GCP 11%, Alibaba 4%.
